postload_actions.text: ...and that was the end of my stay in Ball Hell.
As I rose back to the land of the living, the strange realm I'd escaped from began to seem like a blur. I thought again of the life I'd left behind.
I was coming home. Home to the debt, to problems at the office... to silver balls, tumbling through pins like so many -
Wait. Was that - was that my stop? I'm at the surface already?

FLOOR B1. 
 JUST DESSERTS AND SEALING YOUR DOOM. 
 PLEASE DISEMBARK.
I - I think there's been some mistake -
I'M AFRAID DISEMBARKING IS MANDATORY, PA-CHUMP-O MAN... THIS ELEVATOR ISN'T GOING ANYWHERE WITHOUT MY SAY. BWA HA HA!
